title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
abstract: arXiv:2606.16620v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods often derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We identify a second, fully \emph{deterministic} and \emph{complementary} axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollouts that solve different subsets of problems, with no stochasticity. We instantiate this axis through \emph{Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion} (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that, combined with temperature sampling, turns a single-axis rollout pool into an $L\!\times\!T$ Cartesian sampling space at almost the same per-rollout cost. translated_abstract: 推理时扩展已成为提升语言模型推理能力的主要手段，但现有方法通常仅从单一来源获取展开多样性：随机的词元级采样。我们识别出第二个完全*确定性*且*互补*的扩展轴：层跨度 $L$，即在高不确定性词元处递归地重新应用冻结模型的顶部解码器层所涉及的层数范围。不同的 $L$ 选择会产生不同的展开结果，能够解决不同的问题子集，且不含任何随机性。我们通过熵门控潜在递归（EGLR）来实现这一扩展轴，这是一种无需训练的解码流程，与温度采样相结合后，能够以几乎相同的单次展开成本，将单轴展开池转变为 $L\times T$ 的笛卡尔采样空间。在 8 个指令微调模型和 6 个数学基准上，沿 $L$ 轴进行多数投票在几乎所有设置中都能达到或超越贪婪解码的效果。
tldr: 本文提出无需训练的熵门控潜在递归（EGLR）解码方法，通过在高不确定性词元处递归应用冻结模型顶层解码器层，以确定性的层跨度选择作为新的推理时扩展轴，与温度采样结合形成笛卡尔采样空间，在几乎不增加成本的情况下提升语言模型的数学推理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that introduces a fully deterministic layer-span axis—recursively re-applying a frozen model's top decoder layers at high-uncertainty tokens—as a complementary inference-time scaling lever, which combined with temperature sampling turns a single-axis rollout pool into an L×T Cartesian sampling space that matches or improves greedy decoding via majority voting at almost no extra per-rollout cost.
